functions.name: BSP_EntityManager_Update
functions.behavior: Reads the world object through the game singleton at 00e188a8, returns when [game+19CCh]+4ACh is zero, otherwise dispatches vtable slot 1 (vtable+4) on the sub-manager at this+8h with the scaled delta.

functions.name: BSP_BotScheduler_Update
functions.behavior: Two countdowns and one accumulator gated on game+1FE4h being 0 or 1 and this+1498h. The retarget timer at +149Ch reloads from +14A8h and runs 0075b430(15h) plus eight passes over the 284h-stride records at +1E4h (00914390 when +14A4h is set; CG_adjustor_thunk_0076a9f0 with code 12h when the mode is exactly 1). The think timer at +1494h reloads from +14ACh and runs eight passes of 00911e80 then 00912a60. Separately, when the mode is not 2 and +14A4h is set, +14A0h accumulates the delta.

functions.name: BSP_MarkerManager_Update
functions.behavior: Five std::list walks. +14h and +20h are two-level: the inner list sits at value+8h and value+10h respectively, and each inner element's object at +0Ch gets vtable slot 1 with the delta. +2Ch writes target+94h = |cos(2*(game+64Ch - 00e19970))| * 0.28. +38h calls 006dbac0(target, 1, 0, 1.0f). +44h reads four floats with vtable+54h, replaces the fourth with |cos(...)| * 0.75 + 0.25, and writes them back with vtable+50h.

functions.name: BSP_EntityWorld_FlushActivations
functions.behavior: Walks the intrusive chain from [this+4h] linked through node+38h and calls 00922fd0(node) when node+5Eh is set, node+6Ch is clear and either node+3Ch is null or its +5Eh is clear. 00922fd0 sets +5Eh and +5Dh, clears +5Ch, latches +6Ch, recurses over children from node+48h linked through +44h, and tail-calls virtual +84h.

functions.name: BSP_MissionEvents_Update
functions.behavior: 00982540, then this+198h accumulates the delta and is reset to zero (not decremented) with 00977990 once it exceeds 4.0f (00ce3d34), then 0096d540 and 00968550. Returns when the +E0h list size at +E8h is zero. Walking it, an event whose clock 00f876a4 minus its vtable+1Ch start time has reached its +10h duration is destroyed through vtable+0h(1), unlinked, freed, and the routine returns, abandoning any selection. Otherwise 005b71d0(event+14h) marks it ready and the strictly highest vtable+18h priority wins; 00974070 applies it at the end.

functions.name: BSP_PowerUpManager_Update
functions.behavior: 008eac80, then sixteen channel lists at this+84h with stride 0Ch: any node whose value+18h float is below the clock 00f876a4 gets 008e8c30(value), with no erase. Then the per-player list at this+14Ch + slot*0Ch for the active local-player slot game+18ECh: the deadline is value+18h, or *(value+10h)+80h plus the clock when value+1Ch is set, so the relative form fires only once that source float is negative. Crossing it latches value+8h and, when the ready list size at this+28h + slot*0Ch is non-zero, builds 'pup_ready' and calls 009789a0(slot, readyHead->_Prev + 8, &string). 00613760 runs at the end of every iteration.

functions.name: BSP_Game_RecordActionDeadlines
functions.behavior: Sixteen blocks. Each fetches the input singleton with 004bec00, applies the 004c43c0 edge test to one 30h-byte record at inputSingleton+4h + id*30h (record+28h set, +24h > 0, and either +20h clear or +1Ch <= 0), and on a press writes game+64Ch + 0.4 into the std::map<int,float> at 00e18a7c through operator[] at 004d6900, whose ECX is the literal 0E18A7Ch.

uncertainties: No RTTI locator at vtable-4 for any of the four objects, so all names are behavioural hypotheses, not recovered symbols.
8 records of 284h bytes from game+21A0h+1E4h would end at +1604h, past the 14B8h allocation; only the first dword of each is read, so the count and the stride are solid but the record size is not.
game+19CCh's allocation size and constructor arguments were not recovered.
game+21D0h+8h, the object the entity forwarder dispatches on, is written by 0049d690, which was not read.
The stack payload 00914ef0 hands to CG_adjustor_thunk_0076a9f0 (vtable PTR_LAB_00d035b8, code 12h at +184h, slot at +180h) has an untraced consumer; 0075b430(15h) is likewise unread.
00987590's vtable+18h and vtable+1Ch are read as priority and start time from how they combine; 005b71d0 is read as a readiness predicate. None of the three bodies was read.
Marker vtable slots 50h and 54h are read as a colour setter and getter from the shared four-float buffer; neither body was read.
DAT_00e1aea0, DAT_00f88c30, DAT_00f89b3c, DAT_00e18a7c and the writer of 00e19970 were not traced.
008eb110's 009789a0 and 008e8c30 were not read; the ready list is observed only through its _Mysize gate and its _Prev element.
